example_summary: Calculation of Marginal Relief for Y Ltd. on total income of ₹ 10,01,00,000 for A.Y. 2026-27.
source_provision:
### **Domestic Company Income Tax Framework: Rates, Surcharge & Marginal Relief**

#### **1. Tax Rates & Turnover Threshold Matrix**

| Criteria / Regime | P.Y. Turnover Threshold | Base Tax Rate | Surcharge (> ₹ 1 Cr to ₹ 10 Cr) | Surcharge (> ₹ 10 Cr) | Health & Education Cess |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Domestic Company** | Turnover in P.Y. 2023-24 $\le$ ₹ 400 Crore | **25%** | **7%** | **12%** | **4%** |
| **Standard Domestic Company** | Turnover in P.Y. 2023-24 $>$ ₹ 400 Crore | **30%** | **7%** | **12%** | **4%** |
| **Section 115BAA Regime** | No turnover limit | **22%** | **10% (Flat)** | **10% (Flat)** | **4%** |
| **Section 115BAB Regime** | New Manufacturing | **15%** | **10% (Flat)** | **10% (Flat)** | **4%** |

---

#### **2. Statutory Conditions Checklist**

- **Turnover Benchmark Test**: Base tax rate of 25% applies for Assessment Year 2026-27 only if Total Turnover / Gross Receipts in Financial Year 2023-24 does not exceed ₹ 400 Crore.
- **Surcharge Escalation Rule**: Surcharge is levied at 7% when Total Income exceeds ₹ 1 Crore up to ₹ 10 Crore, and increases to 12% when Total Income exceeds ₹ 10 Crore.
- **Marginal Relief Scope**: Operates at two threshold boundaries: ₹ 1 Crore and ₹ 10 Crore, limiting total tax increase to the excess income earned.

---

> [!IMPORTANT] Marginal Relief Statutory Formula (> ₹ 10 Crore Threshold)
> **Step 1:** Calculate Tax Payable on Total Income @ Base Rate + Surcharge @ 12% (Tax A).
> **Step 2:** Calculate Tax Payable on ₹ 10 Crore @ Base Rate + Surcharge @ 7% (Tax B).
> **Step 3:** Compute Income Exceeding ₹ 10 Crore = Total Income - ₹ 10 Crore (Excess Income C).
> **Step 4:** Cap on Tax Payable (before Cess) = Tax B + Excess Income C.
> **Marginal Relief** = Tax A - Cap on Tax Payable.

director.justification: The provision applies a sharp surcharge jump at the ₹ 10 Crore threshold for Y Ltd., requiring a statutory cap to ensure the additional tax does not exceed excess income earned above ₹ 10 Crore.
director.visual_metaphor: A protective tax-capping barrier preventing the surcharge jump from consuming income beyond the boundary.
